snippet.title: THE LIFT - Developer Deep Dive | Future Games Show Summer Showcase
snippet.description:
The next playtest of THE LIFT begins June 14. Sign up now for a chance to participate: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3283240/THE_LIFT_Supernatural_Handyman_Simulator/

Coming to PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S in 2027!

This Developer Deep Dive, which premiered during the Future Games Show Summer Showcase 2026, takes you behind the scenes of THE LIFT, our first-person sci-fi renovation simulator where satisfying handyman gameplay meets a mysterious narrative-driven adventure.

Discover how we're building a highly interactive world inside a massive abandoned research facility drifting through the void. Learn about our approach to environmental interaction, creating rewarding repair mechanics through sound design and feedback, and designing the wide range of repair challenges you'll encounter throughout the Institute.

Key Game Features:
- Satisfying handyman simulator gameplay
- Narrative-driven sci-fi mystery
- Massive research complex to explore and renovate
- Complex electrical engineering puzzles and repairs
- Crafting and recycling systems
- Highly interactive environments
- Fully voiced characters and quests
- World inspired by Soviet sci-fi and SCP Foundation

Wishlist THE LIFT and follow development for future updates, playtests, and announcements!
